intro: Nordic-spruce garden rooms, log cabins, saunas and wood-fired hot tubs, sold as flat-pack kits and delivered across mainland Ireland, with optional installation by the supplier's own team.
standfirst: Gardenhouse24 is run by ABC Gardenhouse IRL Ltd, with a showroom in Limerick. Its buildings are solid log construction in Nordic spruce. Each one starts as a kit, and the foundation, roof covering, insulation, electrics and installation are chosen and priced separately. The selection below is PlotNua's, from photographs of completed builds wherever the supplier publishes them.

costs.title: What the listed price covers
items: The building kit: walls, floor and roof boards, doors and windows, as each product lists. The listed price is for the kit.
Free kerbside delivery to mainland Ireland on orders over €1,000. The lorry needs a space about 10 m long and 4.5 m wide to unload; hard-to-reach sites need specialist delivery at extra cost.
Optional, and priced per product: €1,430 to €3,030 for the products shown here.

Not included. The base must be level and able to carry the building. The supplier sells foundation options (on the Q-BIC 44 A page, for example, from €840 for a self-assembly base to €2,835 for a concrete base).
Not included as standard on most flat-roofed models (felt or EPDM is extra). The LEO barrel sauna includes bitumen shingles.
Extras. On the Q-BIC 44 A page, floor and roof insulation starts at €1,400 and the electrical package is €3,000. The saunas' electric heaters are sold only with the electrical service package.
costs.note: Prices were checked on 4 November 2026. The supplier is advertising a November promotion, so the price you are quoted may differ. Confirm the current price and what it includes with the supplier.

considerations: Many garden buildings in Ireland can be built without planning permission if they meet the conditions for exempted development, which cover size, height, position and use. A building that is exempt cannot be lived in. Check your plans with your local authority before you buy, especially for the largest cabins: the KAARLO 44's base, terrace included, is about 37 m².
These are solid single-skin log walls. If you want to use a room through the winter, budget for the insulation packages and a 70 mm wall option where one is offered.
8 to 12 weeks for the products shown, depending on the model, as listed on each product page.
An anti-rot warranty of up to 5 years, depending on the product (some product pages list 10 years). It depends on the timber being treated and maintained as the supplier instructs.
